$comment: Node-graph specs for the default colour pipeline. Resolve's API cannot create nodes: build each graph once by hand from this spec, Grab Still > Export as .drx next to this file, then resolve_assemble.py applies it to every clip.

projectSettings.note: Use Rec.709-A instead of Gamma 2.4 only for Mac/QuickTime-viewed web deliverables (compensates the 1.96 display gamma tag).

DLogM_to_709.source: DJI Mini 4 Pro / Osmo Action 6 D-Log M

nodes.label: IN CST
nodes.reason: Linearise the camera log into the scene-referred working space; all following grades are exposure-linear.

nodes.label: EXPOSURE / WB
nodes.reason: Balance in a scene-referred space so stops behave identically across clips.

nodes.label: CONTRAST
nodes.reason: Pivot at working-space mid-grey keeps skin/foliage mids stable while shaping contrast.

nodes.label: SAT / HUE
nodes.tool: Color Slice or HSV sat curve
nodes.reason: Foliage greens and sky blues from D-Log M are low saturation by design.

nodes.label: NR (optional)
nodes.reason: 1/1.3-inch sensors at ISO >= 400 show chroma noise in shadows; NR before the output CST.

nodes.label: OUT CST
nodes.reason: Display render: compresses highlights and out-of-709 colours instead of clipping them.

HLG_to_709.source: DJI Mini 4 Pro HLG / Osmo Action 6 HLG (10-bit Rec.2100)

nodes.label: IN CST
nodes.reason: HLG is display-referred-ish; mapping into DWG/Intermediate lets one grade stack serve both cameras.

nodes.label: OUT CST
nodes.reason: Same output transform as D-Log M => matched look across sources.
